source.note: Transcribed from aesop; aesop's src/types.ts and schema are LOCKED upstream — this file mirrors, never extends, their vocabulary.

primitives.title: Instructions
primitives.semantics: Ordered instruction blocks (global, project, or path-scoped) render into every selected harness's native instruction file plus the portable AGENTS.md. Global blocks are durable personal preferences; project blocks are repo truth — never mixed. Each emitted file stays under roughly 250 lines so it survives context compaction.

fields.name: blocks
fields.note: items are {scope, content}; scope pattern is global | project | path:<glob>

primitives.title: Skills
primitives.semantics: Canonical form is a converged SKILL.md folder (frontmatter name + description, then body, plus optional scripts/, references/, assets/). Progressive disclosure is the point: the description is always in context, the body loads on trigger, bundled files load on demand. The description is the API — a tight, boring description beats a clever one.

fields.name: description
fields.note: frontmatter; the description is the API

primitives.title: Subagents
primitives.semantics: One YAML role file naming the job, the narrowest tool set, a model tier or pin, an effort level, and a prompt body. One job per agent; read-only by default, the main agent does the edits. Maker versus checker is the highest-value split — the reviewer is pinned to a stronger model at higher effort than the maker.

fields.name: tools
fields.note: default ["read"]; narrowest set the job needs

primitives.title: Commands / prompts
primitives.semantics: A prompt file plus an optional args schema, for inner-loop workflows a human triggers repeatedly — distinct from skills, which the agent pulls in on its own.

primitives.title: MCP servers
primitives.semantics: One canonical server spec (name, transport, command or url, env-var names only, scopes, trust tier) emits to every harness's own MCP config location. The trust field feeds the permissions primitive: an irreversible-trust server is automatically human-gated. Default posture is zero MCP servers until a workflow needs one.

fields.name: env
fields.note: env var NAMES only — values never enter the manifest or emitted files

primitives.title: Hooks
primitives.semantics: An event, a matcher, and a shell action that carry hard policy — rules that must hold even when the model doesn't comply, such as format-on-write or a dangerous-command block. On harnesses without native hooks, the emitter falls back to a git pre-commit wrapper and says so.

primitives.title: Permissions
primitives.semantics: Three tiers mapped per harness: read (free), mutate (allowlist/policy-checked), and irreversible (human approval — deploys, pushes to default branch, data deletion, spending). The unattended block names the only sanctioned skip-permissions context, the devcontainer recipe.

primitives.title: Loops & goals
primitives.semantics: A goal recipe: a measurable goal, a verify command as the mechanical stopping condition, and three required hard stops (iteration ceiling, no-progress detector, budget ceiling) — the schema rejects a recipe without them, never defaulted in silently. Compiles to native /goal, the portable Ralph runner, orchestration, or scheduled automations depending on the harness.

fields.name: name
fields.note: path-safe identifier — becomes a filename under .aesop/goals/

fields.name: stops.budget_usd
fields.note: all three stops required — never defaulted in silently

primitives.title: State & memory
primitives.semantics: Pure convention, identical everywhere: tasks/todo.md (current plan, checkboxes) and tasks/lessons.md (mistake-to-rule log, read at session start), optionally tasks/notes/. Durable state lives on disk, not in context — the agent forgets between runs, the repo doesn't.

fields.name: lessons.md
fields.note: mistake-to-rule log, read at session start
